''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the {{#switch: {{{1}}}|1|1 BBY=events that prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]] in {{Film|IV}} to [[1 BBY]]|0=[[Battle of Yavin]] to "0" in [['ABY-BBY' dating system]]|0 ABY=[[Royal Award Ceremony]] to [[0 ABY]]|events that prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]] in {{Film|IV}} to [[1 BBY]], Battle of [[Yavin 4|Yavin]] to "0," and the [[Royal Award Ceremony]] to [[0 ABY]] respectively}}. As ''[[Phineas and Ferb: Star Wars]]'' takes place concurrently with and overlaps with ''A New Hope'', it must take place during this timeframe as well.<noinclude>
